title: Cleanup never deletes a live agent's build folders
why: Your ask (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh239AWxeRqxYqdRJxDTTE96w): the agent-end reap deletes DerivedData and .build while a process still runs, and the moment an agent ends, though a finished agent is resumed into its own worktree, so it rebuilds from nothing and loads the Mac.
note: Part 1 merged in batch #737 (main b09aece, Oct 28 01:19 CDT): PR #720 keeps build folders while a process runs in the agent worktree. Next cloud lane, part 2: build folders follow the worktree's 30-minute idle clock, reaped only in agent worktrees idle 30 min or more at a later agent end, keeping #720's process gate (a long build makes no git activity). Windows runs the same code. Parked, later: what drove the Mac to load 123 (several xcodebuild and simulator runs at once?) and a proposed cap. Needs no answer. Port: no; the janitor installs from here. Placed ahead of c82 (triage, Oct 28): a lane is open on it now.
